_note: Texts of Setup.exe (S_*), install.bat (B_*) and uninstall.bat (U_*). gen_setup_lang.py makes the installer's lang.nsh and the kit's files\lang\setup_<code>.bat from these files. Keep {NAME} (Dungeon Settlers Modded), {INSTDIR} (the install folder) and {BUILD} (the Steam build number) as they are. B_ and U_ texts: no % " ! characters.
S_WELCOME:
This installs {NAME}: a mod loader for Dungeon Settlers, with the Multiplayer, Custom Modes, Hell difficulty and cooldown mods.

It plays a copy of the game. Steam's game, your normal saves and your settings do not change.

Quit Dungeon Settlers before you continue.
S_GAME_TOP:
This is the folder of Dungeon Settlers in Steam (it has DungeonSettlers.exe). It is only read, never changed.

To find it: in Steam, right-click Dungeon Settlers, click Manage, then Browse local files.
S_INST_SUB: Where the modded copy of the game goes (about 1 GB).
S_INST_TOP: {NAME} goes into its own folder named "{NAME}" (added to the folder you choose when its name is different). That folder must be new, empty or an earlier {NAME} install.
S_NO_EXE: DungeonSettlers.exe is not in this folder. Choose the Dungeon Settlers folder of Steam.
S_BADPATH:
The game will not start from this folder:
{INSTDIR}

Its path has letters the game cannot read on this PC (for example Chinese or Japanese letters).
Choose a folder with plain letters only, for example C:\Games\{NAME}.
S_BADPATH_LOG: The game will not start from {INSTDIR} (letters it cannot read). Nothing was changed.
S_OTHER_FILES:
{INSTDIR} already holds other files.
Choose another folder: {NAME} needs a new or empty folder of its own.
S_OTHER_FILES_LOG: {INSTDIR} already holds other files. Nothing was changed.
S_OTHER_FILES_STOP: {INSTDIR} already holds other files. Nothing was changed. Choose a new or empty folder.
S_COPYING: Copying the game (about 700 MB). This takes a minute or two.
S_FAILED: The install did not finish. The reason is in the list above.
S_DONE: Done. Double-click {NAME} on your desktop to play.
S_UN_RUNNING: Dungeon Settlers is running. Close the game, then uninstall again.
S_UN_NO_LIST: This folder has no install file list. Nothing was removed.
S_UN_LEFT: Some files could not be removed. Close the game, then uninstall again.
S_UN_DONE:
{NAME} is removed. Steam's game was never changed.
Your modded saves stay in {INSTDIR}\profiles. You can delete that folder if you do not need them.
B_NOT_FOUND: The game folder was not found automatically.
B_FIND_1: 1. Open Steam. Right-click Dungeon Settlers. Click Manage, then Browse local files.
B_FIND_2: 2. Click the address bar at the top of that folder window. Press Ctrl+C.
B_FIND_3: 3. Click this window. Press Ctrl+V, then press Enter.
B_NOT_IN_FOLDER: DungeonSettlers.exe is not in that folder.
B_WRONG_VERSION: Your game version is not the version this kit is for (Steam build {BUILD}).
B_WRONG_VERSION_2: Nothing was changed. Look for a newer kit on the download page.
B_RUNNING: Dungeon Settlers is running. Close the game, then run install.bat again.
B_BASELIB_MISSING: The game file baselib.dll is missing.
B_BASELIB_CHANGED: The game file baselib.dll is not the original one.
B_VERIFY: In Steam, right-click Dungeon Settlers, click Properties, Installed Files, Verify integrity of game files.
B_HAVE_COPY: The game copy is already there (build {BUILD}).
B_COPYING: Copying the game (about 700 MB, this takes a minute or two) ...
B_DONE: Done. Dungeon Settlers Modded is installed.
B_DONE_PLAY: To play with mods: double-click Dungeon Settlers Modded on your desktop.
B_DONE_STEAM: To play the normal game: start it from Steam as usual. Steam's game is not changed.
B_OTHER_FILES: This folder already holds other files:
B_OTHER_FILES_2: Nothing was changed. Choose an empty folder, or a new one.
B_BADPATH: The game will not start from this folder:
B_BADPATH_WHY: Its path has letters the game cannot read on this PC (for example Chinese or Japanese letters).
B_BADPATH_ASK: Type a folder with plain letters only and press Enter, for example:
B_BADPATH_STOP: Or press Enter alone to stop.
B_COPY_FAILED: The game could not be copied into this folder:
B_COPY_FAILED_2: Close the game and check that the disk has 1 GB free. Then run install.bat again.
U_NOT_INSTALLED: Dungeon Settlers Modded is not installed.
U_RUNNING: Dungeon Settlers is running. Close the game, then run the uninstall again.
U_NO_LIST: This install has no file list (an older kit). Nothing was removed.
U_NO_LIST_2: Install this kit once over it, then uninstall again.
U_LEFT: Some files could not be removed. Close the game, then run the uninstall again.
U_DONE: Done. The modded game copy is removed. Steam's game was never changed.
U_SAVES: Your modded saves are kept in this folder:
U_SAVES_2: You can delete that folder if you do not need them.
